title: Comparison of calibration methods for flow heat-capacity calorimeters and heat capacities of concentrated NaCl(aq) to 598 K
authors: P. S. Z. Rogers, C. J. Duffy
experimental_method: Twin-cell flow heat-capacity calorimeter of Pt-Rh capillary, calibrated by flow withdrawal with one or both heaters on (flow-rate-dependent correction factor f); NaCl(aq) 1 to 6 mol/kg, 323 to 598 K at about 7 and 20 MPa and at 523 K to 36 MPa.
uncertainties_stated: Per-point one standard deviation s (in units of R) printed; pressure +/-0.01 MPa read, transducer calibrated to 0.1 MPa; block temperature controlled to 0.01 K.
quality_remarks: Cp,phi printed divided by R (R value not stated; implied 8.314). Temperatures are midpoints of the temperature rise. Repeated injections of the same solution are listed individually. All values internally consistent with eq (22) and the printed cp,w after correction.
